ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Potential Suspicious Remote Command Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes launched via the ScreenConnect client service.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\ScreenConnect\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*run\\\.cmd.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wevtutil\\\.exe$")))
